name: Astral Storm Islands
introDiscord:
Floating islands hang inside an underwater thunderstorm.

Lightning travels between stars instead of clouds.

Astral Storm Rocs fly through water as though it were open sky.
introTwitch:
Floating islands hang inside an underwater thunderstorm.

Lightning travels between stars instead of clouds.

Astral Storm Rocs fly through water as though it were open sky.

astral-storm-islands-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Astral Storm Islands.

left.message:
One Berry is tied down beneath seventeen knots.

Shizuki wrote:

'Storm stole lunch once.

NOT AGAIN.'

right.message: A cache is wedged beneath a floating island.

forward.message: An Astral Storm Roc dives through lightning.

astral-storm-islands-depths.prompt: Deeper within Astral Storm Islands, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A Roc rides a thunderbolt toward you.

right.message: A calm eye between storm bands restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: Star Candies rain upward from a broken cache.

astral-storm-islands-threshold.prompt: Near Eye of the Drowned Sky, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message:
A coffer rests on the underside of an island.

Naturally.

right.message: An Astral Storm Roc sweeps beneath the floating landmass.

forward.message: Shizuki's old storm shelter somehow still exists.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Eye of the Drowned Sky
boss-antechamber.prompt: Eye of the Drowned Sky goes completely still.

bossPromptDiscord:
Eye of the Drowned Sky goes completely still.

An enormous wing passes over every floating island at once.

Use /yes to enter or /no to allow weather to remain
someone else's problem.
bossPromptTwitch:
Eye of the Drowned Sky goes completely still.

An enormous wing passes over every floating island at once.

Use !yes to enter or !no to allow weather to remain
someone else's problem.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Eye of the Drowned Sky. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Lightning outlines an immense bird.

Firmament Roc reveals itself!

completionText:
The storm breaks.

One of Shizuki's knots has somehow become eighteen.
